sourceRefs.locator: IV.22, MGH SS rer. Merov. 1.1, pp. 154–155. Chilperic uses royal treasure and enters Paris. His brothers dislodge him. The narrative pairs each of the four kings with a predecessor and a sedes.

pp. 223–225, 237–239 and nn. 64–67. Shares in cities and aristocratic loyalty in the Treaty of Andelot. Gregory’s use of Burgundy and Austrasia, absence of Neustria in his work, and the emergence of the three regional kingdoms.

summary.de: Sohn Chlothars I. Gregor verbindet seinen Anteil bei der Nachfolge von 561 mit Paris.
summary.en: Son of Chlothar I. Gregory associates his share in the succession of 561 with Paris.
